findings.message: Function create_function() is deprecated since PHP 7.2 and removed since PHP 8.0; Use an anonymous function instead

Declaring an optional parameter before a required parameter is deprecated since PHP 8.0. Parameter $selected is optional, while parameter $label is required. The $selected parameter is implicitly treated as a required parameter.
